scope: Bounded retrospective observable search, not predictive evidence.
optimizer: Batched complex QR projectors; Adam 800 iterations plus L-BFGS 180 iterations.
positive_control: Uniform L12 G2 t1 upper-band count is already known to violate the bound.
physical_operator: m=c^dagger P c /2, with a general 2L-mode orthogonal projector P; no seniority projection of the operator.
failure_rule: A nonpositive best found value does not prove a global absence of violations.
